summary: Ambient CSS v3 is a CSS animation library that brings Blender‑generated motions into web pages, allowing realistic motion directly in the browser. It is distributed as an npm package and runs without any external API keys. The library is suited for front‑end developers who want high‑fidelity animations without hand‑coding keyframes. It stands out for its unique Blender integration, though reviews note usability and performance concerns.
